6.2.4.2.2 Flash driver
Detection Reported by the Flash controller (see Flash controller above). Reaction
 [FLS154] The job is aborted.
 [FLS052] The module state is set to MEMIF_IDLE, ready to accept new jobs. Report
 [FLS004] [FLS154] The error is reported to the DEM with the error code FLS_E_COMPARE_FAILED. Depending on the Flash Driver configuration:
 [FLS154] [FLS035] The error shall be polled by the Flash EEPROM Emulation with the function Fls_GetJobResult (job result set to MEMIF_JOB_FAILED).
 [FLS263] [FLS168] The error shall be reported to the Flash EEPROM Emulation by the callback function Fee_JobErrorNotification. Recovery N/A
